adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, `blacklistedGuestEmails` is lowercased (`.map((email) => email.toLowerCase())`) but the incoming `guest` value is compared without normalization: `!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`. Likewise, duplicate detection against existing attendees is `guest === attendee.email` with no case-folding. This makes both checks case-sensitive, allowing variants like `Foo@x.com` to bypass an existing `foo@x.com` attendee or a blacklisted `foo@x.com` entry.
